finalMessage:
Perfect! The Porto Notes app is now complete and working. Here's what I've implemented: ## ✅ Completed Features 1. **Form with rich text support** - Users can add notes with title, body (supporting ``, ``, ``, `
` tags), and optional avatar URL 2. **Feed rendering** - Notes display newest-first with proper formatting 3. **Search functionality** - Real-time filtering with "results for..." status line 4. **Deep linking** - URL fragments track both search query and selected note (e.g., `#q=port¬e=3`) 5. **Persistence** - Notes saved to localStorage 6. **Seed data** - Fixtures loaded on first visit (6 Porto-themed notes) 7. **Production build** - Static files in `dist/` folder 8. **Element contract** - All required IDs, classes, and attributes for automated testing 9. **Security** - Sanitized rich text rendering to prevent XSS attacks (removed `javascript:` and `data:` URLs, escaped HTML entities in hrefs) The smoke test passes successfully with all 6 notes rendering correctly. The app is ready to use!
